title: Combination Sum
description: Given an array of distinct integers `candidates` and a target integer `target`, return the count of unique combinations of candidates where the chosen numbers sum to target. A candidate may be chosen unlimited times.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `target`. Second line contains `n` integers.
hints: This is the unbounded knapsack / coin change combination counting problem.
Outer loop over candidate numbers ensures combinations (not permutations) are counted.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, target = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    cands = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    dp = [0] * (target + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    for c in cands:
        for x in range(c, target + 1):
            dp[x] += dp[x - c]
    print(dp[target])
